parent_objective: audit the M1365 broader public replay pass before any promotion or PPO route
blocked_by: M1365 passed broader public replay but was explicitly non-promotional

public_gates: M1366 must not update actor weights
M1366 must not use private holdout
M1366 must decide the next public evidence step after the M1365 pass

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the broader public replay pass and chooses whether to promote, repeat, or synthesize
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, replay, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the audit treats M1365 as promotion without a promotion manifest
stop if the audit ignores missing private/fresh-scenario evidence
stop if the audit routes directly to PPO without promotion discipline
stop if the audit overclaims self-identification
fallback_plan: if M1365 is enough for a public base proposal, route to promotion-gate design
if old-key diagnostic needs analysis, route to protected diagnostic audit
if branch cadence requires synthesis, route to branch synthesis
if result is ambiguous, route to broader gate repeat
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1365 produced a broader public replay pass on the M1362 alpha 0.1 candidate

admission_evidence: M1365 passed six public replay surfaces
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1366 audits replay and behavior evidence but cannot claim anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: audit must not treat broad replay success as level3 self-identification proof
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1365 broader public replay and behavior artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the broader pass is insufficient for promotion, name the missing evidence before any PPO continuation.
allowed_claims: M1365 broader public replay result audit
no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1365 broader public replay pass should be audited into the next disciplined evidence step without direct PPO, private holdout, or overclaiming.
success_criteria: audit routes to a specific next step
no training, PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit omits M1365 replay or behavior evidence
audit routes directly to PPO without promotion discipline
training, PPO, replay, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1366 passes as an audit only if it routes M1365 without training, replay, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input changes.
